- [source-backed] Theorem 4.8: for \(v=v_{r,s,t,n}\), \(\mathfrak S_v=s_{i^j}\), \(a=\min(n-r-i,r-j)\), and \(b=\min(i,j)\), \(J_v\subseteq\Lambda/I_{r,n-r}\) is generated by either \(\{s_\mu:i^j\subseteq\mu\subseteq((i+a)^b,i^{j-b})\}\) or \(\{s_\mu:i^j\subseteq\mu\subseteq(i^j,b^a)\}\). [doi:10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3, lines 864-876]
- [source-backed] The introduction conjectures minimality of the smaller \(J_v\)-generating set and states that this would imply a conditional exponential lower bound on generators of \(I_w\). [doi:10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3, lines 202-211]
- [source-backed] Conjecture 4.10 asserts that both Theorem 4.8 families are minimal; the authors report computer verification only for \(r\le4\), \(n-r\le5\), and conditionally obtain \(\binom{2m}{m}\) generators when \(n=4m\), \(r=n-r=2m\), \(i=j=m\). [doi:10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3, lines 938-955]
- [source-backed] With \(M=J_{v_{r,s,t,n}}\), the source conjectures that \(M/\Lambda_+M\) requires \(\binom{a+b}{a}\) generators and suspects \(M/\Lambda_+M\cong\mathbb Z^{\binom{a+b}{a}}\), adding that a proof had eluded the authors. [doi:10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3, lines 956-975]
- [source-backed] The source distinguishes conjectured minimality for each \(J_v\) family from concatenated Theorem 4.8 families for \(I_w\), which are not minimal in general. [doi:10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3, lines 976-994]
- [source-backed] The introductory `question` hits request efficient generators for \(I_w\) and state that simple presentations in other root systems appear less studied. [doi:10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3, lines 85-106]
- [source-backed] Question 5.1 asks for a minimal generating set of \(I_w\) in type \(A_{n-1}\), including the subclasses of inclusion-defined and smooth Schubert varieties specified by the displayed avoidance conditions. [doi:10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3, lines 1143-1156]
- [source-backed] The remaining positive hit is the bibliography title “From Bruhat intervals to intersection lattices and a conjecture of Postnikov,” not a conjectural assertion of this source. [doi:10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3, lines 1245-1248]
